meta.title: Auto-continue after usage limits
meta.description: Resumes an interrupted conversation by itself when a spent model usage limit resets, with an on/off switch and a configurable cadence under the composer.

auto.title: Auto-continue
auto.intervalTitle: How often to try again after a usage limit. Click to change it.
auto.intervalPrompt: Minutes between continuations. 0 lets the plugin use the reset time.
auto.intervalInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes, 0 or more.
